description: Provide each sub-issue Plan Inline Agent with its parent's current title and body as read-only background while preserving child scope authority and all ordinary-issue and non-Plan behavior.

tasks.title: Deliver parent background to sub-issue Plan agents
tasks.description: Implement the complete parent-context path from the Issue read side through API-boundary poll-response assembly into `mohist/opencode` prompt composition. Resolve only the current parent title/body for child Plan tasks, label it as read-only background with the child body authoritative for scope, preserve existing prompts when context is absent, and update the canonical issue-breakdown and task-dispatch design documentation.
acceptanceCriteria: A narrow Issue read operation resolves a child's projected `ParentIssueNumber` to the parent Issue's current title and body without assembling or exposing parent comments, attachments, artifacts, children, status, or sibling data; an ordinary issue returns no parent context.

The API poll route performs the cross-domain enrichment while mapping `WorkDispatch` to `WorkDispatchResponse`; `WorkflowItemTranslator`, the Orleans-serialized `WorkDispatch`, Workflow domain types, and `WorkflowRun` metadata/state remain unchanged, so no forbidden `Runner -> Issue` dependency is introduced.

The plain HTTP `WorkDispatchResponse` carries one additive optional `ParentIssueContextResponse` with title/body only, and runner `WorkDispatchResponse`, `RenderedWorkItem`, `ActionContext`, poll mapping, and executor propagation preserve that shape without placing it in task `with`, variables, prompts, or persisted state.

The poll response mapper resolves and populates parent context only for task work with `stage = plan` and `uses = mohist/opencode` whose current issue has a resolvable parent; checks, Build/Check/Integrate tasks, other actions, AgentJob work, detached children, and ordinary Plan issues carry no effective parent context.

For every applicable Plan turn, `mohist/opencode` prepends a deterministic block containing JSON-encoded parent title/body and explicit instructions that it is read-only background and the current child issue body controls delivery scope, then submits the original resolved task prompt unchanged after that block.

When parent context is absent, the exact resolved prompt submitted to `OpenCodeRuntime.runTurn` remains unchanged from current behavior; the action does not query Issues, infer parenthood, or rely on prior AgentSession turns.

Server specs cover parent resolution, current-value reads, detachment, API poll-response Plan/opencode gating, ordinary Plan, non-Plan, checks, unrelated actions, HTTP wire mapping, the title/body-only context shape, and architecture-suite compliance without real external dependencies or wall-clock time.

Runner tests cover poll decoding, executor-to-ActionContext propagation, parent-only text and authority labels in the submitted OpenCode prompt, JSON-safe arbitrary Markdown/delimiters, repetition on each applicable turn, and byte-for-byte prompt preservation when context is absent.

`design/issue-breakdown.md` no longer lists Plan background injection as an unresolved implementation path, and `design/workflow/task-dispatch.md` records the optional parent-context dispatch source, stage/action gate, and runner prompt-composition ownership without adding a public template namespace.

No database migration, public Issue API/CLI/Web change, Orleans `WorkDispatch` change, WorkflowRun metadata/state change, parent-child lifecycle change, approval change, architecture allowlist change, or external dependency is introduced.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/runner`, `npm test -w packages/runner`, and `npm test` pass with all new and existing coverage green.
tasks.output: End-to-end sub-issue Plan parent-context delivery through the server HTTP poll response and runner OpenCode prompt, canonical design documentation updates, and focused server/runner regression coverage.
tasks.notes: Keep this as one atomic vertical slice: the Issue resolver, API response mapper/DTO, runner transport, and OpenCode prompt consumer are unusable independently. The API mapping boundary may depend on both Issue reads and Runner output; do not make `Mohist.Server.Runner` depend on `Mohist.Server.Issue` or alter the architecture allowlist. Preserve Workflow zero-awareness, keep `WorkDispatch` unchanged, use a purpose-built title/body HTTP value rather than a generic related-issue graph, do not add a Body projection or migration, and do not fetch the parent through `mo issue show`. Missing/corrupt relationship policy is outside this change. The single-task dependency graph is acyclic by construction.
